name: Jamal Kazura Aromatics
makes: Minyak attar (alcohol-free perfume oils), in-house blends, oud
story: Described by NHB as Singapore's oldest homegrown perfume business. The founder sold attar to worshippers at Sultan Mosque. Now run by third-generation Samir Kazura.

name: Sifr Aromatics
makes: Small-batch perfume oils, candles, bespoke scents, workshops
story: Johari Kazura, the Grasse-trained grandson of the Kazura founder, runs it with partner Lizzie You. A modern offshoot of the family's 1933 business.

name: Thahirah Kazura Pte Ltd
story: Another branch of the Kazura family, now run by Thahirah Kazura. A quiet, low-profile shop.

name: Royal Fragrances
story: One of the Bussorah Street perfume shops.

name: Singapore Memories
makes: Orchid perfumes, room scents, heritage line
story: Revived the 1960s–70s Singapore Girl perfume of the defunct Perfumes of Singapore.

name: Scent by SIX
story: Created Singapore Airlines' signature scent, Batik Flora. Founder Jason Lee previously worked at Givaudan.

name: Maison de L'Asie
makes: Extraits de parfum told in country chapters
story: Chapter 01 is Singapore: Nanyang, Lost Lovers, Mother x Love.

name: Scent Journer
story: Founded by Joyce Lian, a chemistry graduate who previously worked at IFF and Symrise, and incubated at NUS Enterprise. Sold online only for its first eight months; made in Singapore with notes like pandan and Sichuan pepper.

name: Maison 21G
story: Founded in Singapore by French scent designer Johanna Monange, who previously worked at IFF and Firmenich. Built around make-your-own perfume.

name: Oo La Lab
address: 71 Amoy St; Delta House, 2 Alexandra Rd
makes: Craft perfumes; perfume and incense workshops
story: Founded by industry veteran Terry Jacobson around a 27-note 'Chemistry of Oo' table. Ran Scents of the Spice Route (clove, nutmeg, cinnamon) at Singapore HeritageFest 2025.

name: The LAB Fragrances
makes: Hand-blended scents with your name on the label
story: Its best seller is Earl Grey.

name: Nefertum Fragrances
makes: 40+ extraits made in a local factory
story: Founded by a chemist to make scents that last in tropical heat.

name: Epilogue
story: Started by brothers Joshua and Izak Foong in an HDB flat. Its notes include calamansi, rambutan, mandarin and tea.

name: Frmytd
makes: Small-batch scents about memory, from about $30
story: Short for From Yesterday: each scent is built around a remembered moment.

name: Rahasya
story: Founded in 2024 by childhood friends Sai Pogaru, Sachit Sood and Utkarsh Vijayvargiya, inspired by modern India. Now stocked at Selfridges.

name: Aroma Nostalgia
story: Builds scents from the memories and rituals of the Nusantara.

name: ZUBYR Parfums
story: A multi-generational perfumery that teaches traditional blending.

name: Lilee Perfume
story: Each scent explores a philosophical idea, inspired by Nietzsche.

name: Freda'D
story: Founder Faridah Yusuf grew up in her father's perfume store. Runs personality-based perfume workshops.

name: Code Deco
makes: Artisan perfumes, sample sets, subscription club
story: Founded by India-born, Singapore-based perfumer Gauri Garodia, who began her fragrance career at Unilever. Tasman in Grey is her take on a Singapore thunderstorm.

name: Lynk Fragrances
address: Online; stores incl. Changi Airport T2
makes: Candles, home scents, body and hair fragrance
story: A family business that began hand-pouring candles in their kitchen. It has since co-created signature scents for Singapore's MRT stations with SBS Transit.

name: Postcard
makes: 'Anywhere' fragrances to wear or spray on linen
story: Founded by Hildra. Everything is made in-house in a Singapore 'beauty kitchen' with plant-based perfume alcohol.

name: Placement Perfumes
story: An independent perfume studio started by self-taught perfumer Jade Kaur.

name: Bespoke Parfums
story: Run by two Singaporeans, selling hand-blended perfumes on Etsy.

name: stillgoods
makes: Multi-purpose perfume, fabric and room sprays
story: A Singapore lifestyle brand whose small sprays double as perfume, fabric spray or room spray.
